name: Elixion
description:
Elixion is an Engineering Intelligence™ platform: issues, sprints, boards, and projects for software teams.

This connector gives Claude direct access to your Elixion workspace, so you can ask about your work in plain language instead of clicking through a board. Ask what's on your plate, what's blocking the sprint, or what changed on a ticket, and get an answer grounded in your real data.

Claude can search issues with Elixion's query language (EQL), read a full issue including its description, acceptance criteria, subtasks, and comment thread, and see any project's board column by column. It can also do the work: file an issue, update one, move it along the workflow, assign it, comment on it, and create or start a sprint.

You choose which workspace Claude can reach when you connect, and you can revoke that access at any time from your Elixion settings. Read-only access is available if you would rather Claude only look and never touch.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Elixion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Elixion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.elixion.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Elixion MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Elixion lists 50 MCP tools, including add_issue_comment, assign_issue, create_issue, get_board, get_issue, get_project, get_sprint, list_issues, list_projects, list_sprints, manage_sprint, and ping.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Elixion?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Elixion in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Elixion requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Elixion is developed by Elixion Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
